name: Redd Riding
source:
You are lost late at night deep in the country roads of New England, your car broken down, your phone completely out of signal. Fortunately, a passing trucker will be happy to give you a lift.

[From [url=https://bluesquirrel.itch.io/redd-flagg]itch.io[/url]]
